description: From the Xyloskalo trailhead on the Omalos plateau, a stone stair path drops into the upper Samaria Gorge between steep pale limestone walls and dark cypress and pine. The sky is clear, about 6 percent cloud, about 13.8°C at a model elevation of about 1240 m, with wind near 11 km/h. There is no snow and no rain. This is the drive-in overlook, not the Iron Gates farther down the hike.
